soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles brown, pilosity moderate. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.62–0.65, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin broadly rounded, frontal region flat. Labrum ligulate, apex bluntly rounded, apical and subapical setae together with the longer lateral apical setae present. Mandibles nearly straight at the apex and slightly curved; length 0.57–0.63 of head capsule length and 0.92–0.99 of head width. Antennae 14–15 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior fifth; waist region slender and short, its sides broadly arcuate towards front and rear, waist constriction index 0.26–0.29. Pronotum kidney-shaped, about 1.46–1.56 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins both shallowly concave in the middle, the anterior slightly deeper, lateral margins converging steeply posteriorly; about 20 setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.
